CustomField.label: Message When Unable To Evaluate
CustomField.description: Optional. Replaces the default message users see when a check cannot be evaluated - for example a bad query or formula (the "Unable to Evaluate" outcome). Keep it user-friendly; never include SOQL, errors, or technical detail. Supports merge tokens such as {!record.Name}, {!rhcResult.reasonCode}, or {!rhcRun.runId}. Press Enter to start a new line; each line is shown as a separate line on the card.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. Friendly text when the check can't run. Tokens: {!record.FieldApiName}, {!rhcResult.reasonCode}; no SOQL. Press Enter for a new line.
